notes.title: Release and Update 1.5
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945707/8ce0e772254db2a46444be00a61d7ea7e40a31d8.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945707/6f351502421b321c9a2c80059662c2b2ed08de75.jpg[/img][/url]

After one year of early access, Maskonauts: Chat'Attack is now released with the Update 1.5 adding the Maskopod customization and various bugs corrections!

We hope you'll have as much fun playing the game as we had while making it.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Update 1.4.166 is available!
notes.content:
- Added a new save system. Use your Maskoins to create a checkpoint and continue your game on a channel later. You can progress at the same time in as many chains as you wish!
- Minor bug correction.

notes.title: Update 1.4.163 is available!
notes.content: - Balanced blocks damages. Watch out, the pink blocks does damage now!

notes.title: Update 1.4.161 is available!
notes.content:
- Added a scanner feature showing the silhouette of the Blockbosster alongside its channel. It even shows its colors after fighting it once!
- Gameplay balancing.
- Bugs correction.

notes.title: Update 1.4.148 is available!
notes.content:
- We have noticed a new type of behavior regarding Blockbossters. It seems that by dint of undergoing attacks they have learned new defense techniques...
- We have improved the resistance of Maskopods to corruption.

notes.title: Update 1.4.147 is available!
notes.content: We have noticed a new type of behavior regarding Blockbossters. It seems that by dint of undergoing attacks they have learned new defense techniques...

notes.title: Minor bug correction
notes.content: Fixed minor bugs related to Maskopods rental

notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945707/b5bc65c6cb220b26bae077c10832df049d21450e.png[/img]

[b]Update 1.4 is available!
[/b]
It brings a good polish with the following improvements:
[list]
[*] Improved bosses and maskopods sound effects
[*] Gameplay balancing
[*] Interactions with emoji
[*] Bugfixes
[*] Improved general stability
[*] Added credits screen
[/list]

notes.title: First upgrade...
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improvements on the achievements management
[*] A new button on pause screen to toogle the game in fullscreen (the short cut <Alt>+<Enter> is still available :)
[/list]

notes.title: Maskonauts: Chat'Attack is available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945707/817f31462f2f91ab1581577ce42d93986a75c0c3.gif[/img]

Here's the list of features specific to this version.

- Pilot your Maskopod with the mouse, the keyboard or with a compatible controller.
(The menus are only navigable with a mouse at the moment, but we're working on it!)

- Play in resizable widget mode or full screen (Alt+enter) depending on how you play and stream.

- Collect your Maskopay (100 free Maskoins) every hour in the gift menu.

- 30 Steam Achievements to unlock.

- Steam Cloud compatibility.

Maskonauts, we are already at work to fix the first bugs you reported to us!
